quality_rules: Never use parcel area as catchment area.
Never interpret -9999 as a numeric BFE/depth/elevation; preserve raw value and normalize to null.
Do not mix NAVD88, Ohio River Datum, NGVD29, ellipsoidal heights or local datums without documented conversion.
Every downloaded asset must retain source URL, retrieval timestamp, source vintage, CRS/datum, units, quality flags and SHA-256.
No HEC-HMS/HEC-RAS run or design conclusion until the modeling question, outlet, geometry, inputs and review path are approved.
